name: Labubo Project Hub
description: A cute Labubo companion that walks you through your project's process.

phases.title: Discover
phases.summary: Understand what the project needs to do.

steps.title: Define the goal
steps.detail: A companion that shows the project's live process.

steps.title: Sketch the companion
steps.detail: Floating button, speech bubble, progress panel.

steps.title: Pick the tech
steps.detail: Zero-dependency Node server + vanilla JS bundles.

phases.title: Design
phases.summary: Give Labubo a face and the app a lovely look.

steps.title: Draw the Cute Labubo
steps.detail: SVG mascot with ears, fangs and moods.

steps.title: Colour & typography
steps.detail: Warm cream palette with pink accents.

phases.title: Build
phases.summary: Wire the companion to the project data.

steps.title: Static server
steps.detail: node:http server with MIME + path guards.

steps.title: Companion panel
steps.detail: Click Labubo to open the live process view.

steps.title: Live sync
steps.detail: Auto-refresh every few seconds without reload.

phases.title: Verify
phases.summary: Make sure the little one is reliable.

steps.title: Click the Cute Labubo
steps.detail: Check the panel renders your phases.

steps.title: Edit project-status.json
steps.detail: Confirm the panel updates on its own.

phases.title: Launch
phases.summary: Ship it and keep the companion fed.

notes: Edit this file any time — Labubo re-reads it every 5 seconds.
